reason: Conversation 2 correctly explained E17 as a fill-time/supply fault at once, asked about the supply valve first, told the homeowner the half-open lever should be in line with the pipe, and confirmed the fix with a rinse test - no part needed, matching the hidden truth. Conversation 1 never explained E17, wandered into door-lock questions, and when the customer twice volunteered the half-open isolation lever it ignored this obvious clue and kept insisting she disconnect the hose to clean the mesh filter despite her stated reluctance, leaving the fault unresolved. Its safety wording was fine but repetitive, while its diagnosis and listening were poor.
